reason: My cook already makes fresh green chutney in a dabba for free, so paying ₹99 on my salary for a packaged tube makes zero financial sense.
objection: There is no need to buy packaged green chutney when fresh homemade chutney is always sitting in my fridge.
would_change_my_mind: Unique fusion flavors that my cook cannot make, sold in small ₹30 trial pouches on Blinkit.
